resources.string: YouTube on your car screen. Only when you are parked.
Ready. Location and car speed are allowed.
Yuto needs your location to know the car is stopped. Without it, video stays hidden.
Sign in once here, on the phone. The car screen then shows your subscriptions and history. Optional.
Android Auto settings: tap the version 10 times, then the menu ⋮ and Unknown sources.
Plug in the phone and open Yuto from the car app list.
Stop the car: after 10 seconds stopped, the video appears. As soon as it moves, the picture hides and only the sound continues.
Checking that the car is stopped before showing video
The sound keeps playing. Stop in a safe place to watch.
Checking that the car is stopped
Waiting for the car speed or GPS…
Open Yuto on the phone and allow location.
Search is available when the car is parked
Video stays hidden until the stop is confirmed (10 s stopped).
Flexible mode: video shows after 2 s stopped, even if the speed can\'t be read. It still hides as soon as movement is measured.
Off: the picture hides as soon as the car moves. Recommended.
⚠️ On: the video stays visible while you drive. Watching the screen while driving is dangerous and illegal in most countries. Your choice, your responsibility.
Voice recognition is not available on this phone.
Allow the microphone on the phone (in Yuto) to search by voice.
Voice search did not work. Try again.
No phone videos yet. Add some in the Yuto app on the phone.
Pick videos stored on the phone, then open the menu in the car (house button). They play in order and resume where you stopped.
Dims the picture and asks pages for a dark theme. Can also be switched in the car menu.

While parked: start sharing, approve the Android prompt, then open Facebook, Instagram or another video app on your phone. Yuto shows the picture in the car automatically. Control playback on your phone. Portrait videos stay centered with black borders. Protected videos may be black. Sound uses your normal phone / Bluetooth / Android Auto route; it is not captured. Sharing the entire screen can show private notifications. Stop sharing when done.
Sharing is on. Open your video app on the phone.
Start screen sharing in Yuto on the phone
Screen sharing could not start. Please try again and approve the Android prompt.
